mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jade_events(run_id, seq, ts, event_type, data, compact_data) VALUES (#{runId}, #{seq}, #{ts}, #{eventType}, #{data}, #{compactData}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ts=VALUES(ts), event_type=VALUES(event_type), data=VALUES(data), compact_data=VALUES(compact_data)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) FROM jade_events WHERE run_id = #{runId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jade_events WHERE run_id = #{runId}
SELECT 1 FROM jade_events WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND seq < #{seq} LIMIT 1
